hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric reflecting the profitability of long-term site leasing revenues, a structural operational indicator in the telecommunications tower sector
company_description: Crown Castle Inc. owns, operates and leases approximately 40,000 cell towers and approximately 90,000 route miles of fiber. It primarily supports small cells and fiber solutions across every major U.S. market. This nationwide portfolio of communications infrastructure connects cities and communities to essential data, technology and wireless service  bringing information, ideas and innovations to the people and businesses that need them. Crown Castle Inc. was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Houston, United States.

kpis.name: Adjusted Site Rental Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted gross margin of site leasing revenues after deduction of operating costs
kpis.description: Adjusted site rental gross margin decreased by $231 million (7%) primarily due to a $219 million decline in site leasing revenues and a $61 million reduction in prepaid rent amortization. This decline was primarily attributable to $204 million of non-renewals related to the T-Mobile and Sprint network consolidation.
kpis.signal: Decline in adjusted site rental gross margin

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBITDA measuring operating profitability before financing, taxes and non-recurring items
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITDA decreased by $172 million (6%) primarily due to lower site leasing revenues, partially offset by reductions in selling, general and administrative expenses (including costs related to the 2024 proxy contest) and an increase in services and other margins.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Consolidated net income after taxes and extraordinary items
kpis.description: Net income increased to $444 million in 2025 (compared to a loss of $3,903 million in 2024), an improvement of $4.3 billion, primarily due to the absence of a $5.0 billion goodwill impairment charge recorded in 2024 for the Fiber Business classified as a discontinued operation, partially offset by a $1.6 billion loss on the sale of the Fiber Business in the first quarter of 2025.

kpis.name: Site Rental Revenues
kpis.explanation: Annual revenues from leasing telecommunications towers and sites to major carriers
kpis.description: Site rental revenues decreased by $219 million (5%) in 2025 compared to 2024, primarily due to $204 million of non-renewals related to the T-Mobile and Sprint network consolidation, partially offset by new leases and contractual escalations.

kpis.short: Adjusted Services and Other Gross Margin
kpis.name: Adjusted Services and Other Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted gross margin of service and other variable-revenue activities
kpis.description: Adjusted services and other gross margin increased by $16 million (18%) in 2025, reflecting improvements in service volume and mix. These revenues are variable in nature as they are not covered by long-term leasing contracts (unlike site rental revenues).
kpis.signal: Increase in adjusted services and other gross margin

kpis.name: Selling, General and Administrative Expenses
kpis.explanation: Operating expenses for selling, general and administrative functions
kpis.description: Selling, general and administrative expenses decreased by $52 million (12%) in 2025, primarily due to lower legal and consulting fees related to the 2024 proxy contest, as well as cost reductions related to workforce and facilities following the 2023 and 2024 restructuring plans.
kpis.signal: Decline in selling, general and administrative expenses

kpis.name: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion
kpis.explanation: Non-cash expenses related to depreciation of fixed assets and amortization of intangible assets and contracts
kpis.description: Depreciation, amortization and accretion decreased by $46 million (6%) in 2025, primarily resulting from the full amortization of certain fixed assets and intangible assets related to lease contracts and tenant relationships.
kpis.signal: Decline in depreciation, amortization and accretion

kpis.short: Interest Expense and Amortization of Deferred Financing Costs
kpis.name: Interest Expense and Amortization of Deferred Financing Costs
kpis.explanation: Interest expenses and amortization of financing costs related to capital structure
kpis.description: Interest expense and amortization of deferred financing costs increased by $40 million (4%) in 2025, primarily due to higher debt balances used to finance discretionary capital expenditures, including those related to discontinued operations (Fiber Business).
kpis.signal: Increase in interest expense and amortization of deferred financing costs

kpis.name: Provision for Income Taxes
kpis.explanation: Income tax expense reflecting the tax impact of REIT status and use of net operating loss carryforwards (NOLs)
kpis.description: The provision for income taxes of $16 million in 2025 remains minimal due to the company's REIT status and the use of net operating loss carryforwards (NOLs). The effective tax rate differs from the federal statutory rate primarily due to the REIT dividend deduction and the use of federal and state NOLs.
kpis.signal: Decline in provision for income taxes

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.063 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $2.08 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last three fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 468.5% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $4.264 billion in the latest year.
